transactionForm.intro: Record a movement by hand. You enter the taxes yourself: the app does not calculate them.
transactionForm.grossHint: Computed from quantity × price. Type it only to match your broker's statement exactly.
transactionForm.grossForeign: The security is quoted in {{quote}}: type the amount in {{currency}} from your broker's statement.
transactionForm.accruedHint: Moves cash and counts as income, never as cost.
transactionForm.taxesHint: As on the statement: positive if withheld, negative (with −) for a credit.
transactionForm.taxesBuyHint: Bonds only: usually negative (with −), a credit on accrued interest or issue discount.
transactionForm.noCashHint: The security enters the portfolio but the account's cash stays as it is (useful for securities already held or transferred).
transactionForm.noBonds: No bonds yet: coupons are paid by bonds only.
transactionForm.taxesWithheldHint: As on the statement; leave it empty if there are none.
transactionForm.dividendQuantityHint: Optional, for reference only: the number of shares the dividend was paid on.
transactionForm.ratioHint: 2 new for 1 old doubles the quantity; 1 new for 10 old is a reverse split.
transactionForm.grossRecomputed: Computed again from quantity × price, because one of them changed. Type it only to match your broker's statement exactly.
transactionForm.pricesLookedUp: Automatic prices for this ISIN are being looked up.
transactionForm.grossForeignAgain: The quantity, price or security changed: type the amount in {{currency}} again from your broker's statement.
transactionForm.assetCreatedNotBond: Security “{{name}}” created. It is not a bond, so it cannot be chosen for a coupon.

typeHints.BUY: Buy a security: the quantity grows, the average cost is updated and the cash goes down.
typeHints.SELL: Sell a security: the quantity goes down, the average cost stays and the cash goes up.
typeHints.DIVIDEND: A dividend received: gross amount and taxes withheld.
typeHints.COUPON: A bond coupon received: gross amount and taxes withheld.
typeHints.WITHDRAWAL: Money taken out of the account.
typeHints.STOCK_SPLIT: A split or reverse split: the quantity changes, the cost stays.

input.invalid: Not a number: use digits and one decimal separator.

summary.conflictSave: Saving is refused until the quantities add up.

importLines.FOREIGN_CURRENCY: A movement in a currency other than the euro: not imported yet.

importLines.MISSING_PROTOCOL: The row has no protocol number.
importLines.QUANTITY_ON_SIDE_ROW: «{{original_type}}» has a quantity, which this kind of row never has.
importLines.ORDER_WITH_UNRECOGNIZED_ROW: The order contains a row of a type that is not supported («{{original_type}}»).

importLines.ORDER_WITHOUT_MAIN_ROW: The order has no purchase row in this file.
importLines.ORDER_MIXED_DATES: The rows of the order have different dates.
importLines.ORDER_MIXED_ISINS: The rows of the order have different ISINs.
importLines.PAIRING_AMBIGUOUS: The withholding cannot be matched to one dividend or coupon with certainty.
importLines.PAIRED_ROW_REJECTED: Its withholding (row {{line}}) cannot be read: imported alone, it would record no taxes.
importLines.WITHHOLDING_WITHOUT_INCOME: A withholding without its dividend or coupon.

importLines.FIELD_COUNT: The row has {{found}} cells instead of {{expected}}.

importLines.ACCOUNT_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The row is in {{currency}}, the account in {{account_currency}}.
importLines.MERGED_EXECUTIONS: {{count}} executions of the same order, merged.

importNotices.POSSIBLY_TRUNCATED: The file has {{rows}} rows: Directa stops its exports at 3,000, so some movements may be missing. Export a shorter period.
importNotices.MANUAL_OVERLAP: {{account}} already has transactions entered without a broker reference between {{first_date}} and {{last_date}} ({{count}}). If some of them are in this file too, they would be counted twice: check before confirming.
importNotices.ACCOUNT_CODE_DIFFERS: The file is of the Directa account {{file_code}}, while this account remembers {{account_code}}: check that it is the right account.
importNotices.ASSET_DEFINITION_DIFFERS: {{asset}}: the {{field}} in the file differs from your security; yours is kept.

importBlocking.ACCOUNT_CURRENCY_REQUIRED: The account «{{account}}» of the file has no currency: create it with the button below, or choose one of your accounts.

intro.file: Upload the file exported by your broker. Nothing is saved until you confirm the preview.

intro.preview: Check what will be added. Nothing is saved until you confirm.

import.accepted: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV, up to 10 MB
import.tooLarge: This file is larger than 10 MB: it cannot be imported. Export a shorter period.
import.readFailed: The browser could not read this file. Choose it again.
import.moveCashHint: Imports the securities without changing the account's cash; deposits and account expenses are skipped (you can tick them again one by one).
import.supported: Supported formats: Directa (Excel) and the Portfolio Tracker CSV (Settings → Export CSV). The file is read on your server and is not kept.

help.title: Known limits
help.directaNotYet: Sales, withdrawals, bond redemptions, movements in other currencies and corporate actions are not imported yet: they are listed as not recognized and you enter them by hand (a bond redemption is a sale at 100% of nominal).
help.directaExpenses: Stamp duty and the Tobin tax are imported as withdrawals: they move cash but do not count in the returns.
help.directaBonds: Bonds are valued at clean prices.
help.directaReview: A purchase with the row «Rit.credito disaggio» is to review: the broker has not confirmed what it means, so it is imported only if you tick it.
help.csvNames: Accounts are recognized by name, and two accounts can have the same name: give your accounts different names before exporting.
help.csvCurrency: An account of the file without a currency is not created by the import: create it from the preview (its name is filled in) or choose one of your accounts.
help.size: Files up to 10 MB; a Directa export stops at 3,000 rows.

import.accountQuestion: The file does not say which of your accounts it belongs to. Choose it: the account will remember the file's Directa account code for the next imports.
import.onlyEur: Directa files go only into accounts in euro.
import.noEurAccount: You have no account in euro yet.
import.busy: Other imports are running on the server: trying again in {{seconds}} s (attempt {{attempt}} of {{max}}).
